objectives.label: Take back the {cargo} from the robbers on the {other} road

title: The stolen {cargo}
Take back what was ours
summary: Robbers took a load of {cargo} on the road between {settlement} and {other}. Get it back for {giver}.
offer: A season's {cargo}, gone to robbers on the {other} road, {distance} out. Bring it back and you will have your share of it.
complete: That is ours, seal and all. Into the stores it goes — and this is yours.
